question: To whom and under what test must a previously accomplished object be given?
premises: Something is to be given to a previously accomplished person.
That object must have been tested for one year.
The test of one year qualifies the object for giving.
inference: Only an object tested for one year is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished.
plain_english: What has been tested for one year is to be given to one who has accomplished it before.
